method: Five independent interpreter sessions on a prepared SQLite index. Each of 50 requests is sent only after full decoding of its predecessor. First clock includes process launch. Ranking compares the entire displayed ID list in order. The acceptance test uses the unrounded maximum.

diagnostic_stage_seconds.note: Separate untimed-workload replays of the historical outlier questions. Stage timers are wall-clock seconds, not a reconstruction of the original slow requests. Baseline cProfile counted compact() 29846 times on music.
